questions.question: How can users customize the design of slides in Libre Office Impress? Explain different options such as background colors, fonts, and styles. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Explanation of changing background colors: (1 mark)
  • You can change the background color of a slide by going to the "Slide" menu and selecting
  • "Set Background". This allows you to choose from solid colors, gradients, hatches, or image
  • backgrounds.
  • Explanation of changing fonts and text styles: (1 mark)
  • Fonts can be customized by selecting the text box and using the "Format" menu. From here,
  • you can adjust font type, size, style, and color. The "Master Slide" view can be used to set
  • fonts consistently across slides.
  • Explanation of using themes and layouts: (1 mark)
  • Themes can be applied to change the overall design of slides, including backgrounds, colors,
  • and fonts. You can also modify layouts by going to "Master Slide" view and adjusting
  • placeholders and elements, ensuring consistent formatting throughout the presentation.

questions.question: How do you apply a slide transition in Libre Office Impress? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Navigating to the transition option: (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, go to the “Slide Show” menu and select “Slide Transition”.
  • (This opens a sidebar or dialog where you can apply transitions to individual slides.)
  • Selecting a transition effect: (1 mark)
  • From the Slide Transition panel, you can choose a transition style (e.g., Fade, Wipe, Push,
  • Zoom).(These effects determine how the current slide changes to the next one.)
  • Customizing transition settings: (1 mark)
  • You can set options like speed, sound, and whether the transition happens on click or automatically
  • after a time delay.(Click “Apply to All Slides” if you want the same effect on every slide.)

questions.question: Describe the process of saving a presentation in Libre Office Impress. What are the different file formats available, and why is it important to save work frequently? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Process of saving a presentation (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, to save a presentation, click on File > Save or press Ctrl + S. If it’s a
  • new file, a dialog box will appear where you can enter the file name and choose a location. After
  • that, click Save to store the presentation.
  • Different file formats available (1 mark)
  • • .ODP (default OpenDocument Presentation format)
  • • .PPT / .PPTX (Microsoft PowerPoint formats)
  • • .PDF (for exporting as a readable, non-editable file)
  • • .OTP (used for saving templates)
  • Importance of saving work frequently (1 mark)
  • Frequent saving helps avoid data loss due to crashes, power failure, or accidental closure. It
  • ensures that recent changes are not lost and protects the user's effort and time.

questions.question: What types of media can be added to a presentation in Libre Office Impress? Explain how to insert and customize audio or video files. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Types of media that can be added (1 mark)
  • In LibreOffice Impress, you can insert various types of media, including images, audio files, and
  • video files. Supported formats include MP3, WAV (for audio) and MP4, AVI (for video). These
  • elements enhance the presentation's interactivity and appeal.
  • How to insert audio or video files (1 mark)
  • To insert audio or video: Go to Insert > Media > Audio or Video.
  • Select the desired file from your computer. The media object appears on the slide and can be
  • resized or moved like any other object.
  • How to customize audio or video files (1 mark)
  • After inserting, you can: Use the Playback toolbar to play, pause, or stop the media.
  • Set options such as automatic start or play on click.Adjust the volume, and loop playback if
  • needed.

questions.question: How can you share a Google Slides presentation with others? / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Accessing the share option (1 mark)
  • Open the presentation in Google Slides and click on the “Share” button at the top-right corner.
  • This opens the sharing settings window where you can manage access and permissions.
  • Choosing who to share with (1 mark)
  • You can share the presentation by: Entering email addresses of specific people Or by generating
  • a shareable link. You can control access by selecting permissions such as Viewer, Commenter,
  • or Editor for each person or link.
  • Adjusting visibility and privacy settings (1 mark)
  • You can choose whether the file is:
  • Restricted (only invited users can view)
  • Anyone with the link can view, comment, or edit. These settings ensure the right level of
  • security and collaboration based on your needs.

questions.question: Explain how data can be edited in linked charts. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Opening the linked chart for editing (1 mark)
  • To edit a linked chart (e.g., one inserted from Calc into Impress or Writer), double-click the
  • chart. This opens it in Chart Edit mode, allowing access to its data and layout features.
  • Modifying the chart data (1 mark)
  • To change the data: Click “Edit Data” or use the data table that appears.
  • You can directly update values, labels, or categories in the embedded sheet-like editor.
  • Changes are reflected immediately in the chart preview.
  • Updating linked charts (1 mark)
  • If the chart is linked to an external Calc file: Make changes in the source spreadsheet.
  • When you open the document with the linked chart (e.g., Impress), you will be prompted to
  • update the link. Click “Yes” to refresh the chart with the updated data.

questions.question: Explain AI-powered slide design. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Automated slide creation (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design tools automatically generate presentations by analyzing text input or
  • prompts. These tools use machine learning to create slides that are visually appealing and
  • well-structured without requiring manual design effort. For example, tools like Canva Magic
  • Design or Gamma automatically suggest layouts, fonts, colors, and images that align with the
  • content.
  • Personalization and customization (1 mark)
  • AI tools offer customization options, allowing users to tailor the generated designs. Users can
  • modify layouts, colors, fonts, and even content based on specific preferences or branding
  • requirements, ensuring the presentation reflects the desired style and tone.
  • Efficiency and time-saving (1 mark)
  • AI-powered slide design significantly speeds up the presentation creation process. It
  • automates tasks like formatting, content alignment, and design selection, allowing users to
  • focus on refining the message. This is especially beneficial for users with limited design
  • experience or tight deadlines.
